name: Capital Access knowledge capture
description: Interview notes become an approved playbook; teammates then ask cited questions. Targets knowledge that lives inside people’s heads.

steps.label: Draft playbook from notes
steps.input: Turn the Capital Access interview notes into a draft playbook for first-time issuer non-deal roadshows. Keep decision gates and owners explicit.
steps.output:
## Draft playbook — Capital Access NDR prep (awaiting approval)

**Audience:** Capital Access + sector bankers

### Process
1. Build a coverage map of two buy-side accounts that already cover the peer set.
2. Soft block: start CFOs new to group lunches with a friendly long-only 1:1 — never a hedge-fund panel first.
3. Freeze “whisper range” / indicative pricing language until Legal clears the deck.

### Decision gates
| Gate | Owner |
| --- | --- |
| Coverage map signed | Sector banker |
| Forward-looking slides | Compliance |
| Travel window ≥ 10 BD | IR |

_Draft only — not queryable until approved._

steps.label: Ask the approved playbook
steps.input: Per the approved Capital Access playbook, what is the soft block for a CFO who has never done a group lunch?
steps.output:
## Answer (approved playbook)

Schedule a **1:1 with a friendly long-only** first. Do **not** open with a hedge-fund panel.

**Citation:** Capital Access interview notes — Maya Chen (synthetic), “What is not in any system of record.”

_Grounded in the approved playbook derived from the interview notes._
